name: SOF sell hook burns the sold amount from the SOF/USDT pair before the sale
summary: SOF._update() handles a sale to the SOF/USDT pair by burning 90% of the sold amount from the pair's own balance and syncing before the seller's tokens arrive. The attacker flash-bought nearly all pair SOF for a fee-exempt mining contract (buys otherwise revert), then sold 875 SOF: the hook burned the rest of the reserve and the sale took all the pair's USDT.
notes: Immutable token; the constructor fee-excludes the token itself, which already works as a buy recipient, so the later excludeFromFees calls (mining contract) are not needed and deployment sets the age.

Loss is the pair's exact USDT depletion; the flash-loaned buy leg and lender fees are financing and not netted, so it exceeds the attacker's profit. The pair never lost comparable USDT in any other transaction.
